results.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders
FROM olist_orders_dataset;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers FROM olist_customers_dataset;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM olist_customers_dataset;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sellers FROM olist_sellers_dataset;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_products FROM olist_products_dataset;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score)::numeric, 2) AS average_review_score
FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset;

SELECT MAX(review_score) AS highest_review_score
FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset;

SELECT MIN(review_score) AS lowest_review_score
FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(price)::numeric, 2) AS average_price
FROM olist_order_items_dataset;
SELECT MAX(price) AS highest_price FROM olist_order_items_dataset;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(freight_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_freight FROM olist_order_items_dataset;

SELECT SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment_value
FROM olist_order_payments_dataset;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_payment_records
FROM olist_order_payments_dataset;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reviews FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset;
SELECT DISTINCT payment_type FROM olist_order_payments_dataset;
SELECT DISTINCT order_status FROM olist_orders_dataset ORDER BY order_status;

SELECT order_id, order_item_id, product_id, price
FROM olist_order_items_dataset
ORDER BY price DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT product_id, product_weight_g
FROM olist_products_dataset
ORDER BY product_weight_g DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders
FROM olist_customers_dataset c
JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY total_orders DESC;

SELECT c.customer_unique_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_spending
FROM olist_customers_dataset c
JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN olist_order_payments_dataset p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY total_spending DESC;

SELECT product_id, ROUND(AVG(price)::numeric, 2) AS average_price
FROM olist_order_items_dataset
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY average_price DESC;

SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM olist_products_dataset
GROUP BY product_category_name
ORDER BY product_count DESC;

SELECT s.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM olist_sellers_dataset s
JOIN olist_order_items_dataset oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM olist_orders_dataset
GROUP BY order_status
ORDER BY order_count DESC;

SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score)::numeric, 2) AS average_review_score
FROM olist_orders_dataset o
JOIN olist_order_reviews_dataset r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_status
ORDER BY average_review_score DESC;

SELECT seller_id, ROUND(SUM(freight_value)::numeric, 2) AS total_freight
FROM olist_order_items_dataset
GROUP BY seller_id
ORDER BY total_freight DESC;

SELECT payment_type,
       SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment
FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY total_payment DESC;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders_count
FROM olist_orders_dataset
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price)::numeric, 2) AS total_item_revenue
FROM olist_orders_dataset o
JOIN olist_order_items_dataset oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT customer_city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM olist_customers_dataset
GROUP BY customer_city
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

SELECT s.seller_id, COUNT(*) AS items_sold
FROM olist_sellers_dataset s
JOIN olist_order_items_dataset oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY items_sold DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category_name,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.freight_value)::numeric, 2) AS avg_freight
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
       ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
ORDER BY avg_freight DESC;

SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(o.order_id) AS delivered_orders
FROM olist_orders_dataset o
JOIN olist_customers_dataset c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY delivered_orders DESC;

SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(payment_installments)::numeric, 2) AS avg_installments
FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY payment_type;

SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM olist_products_dataset
GROUP BY product_category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000
ORDER BY product_count DESC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp))) / 86400, 2) AS average_delivery_time_days
FROM olist_orders_dataset
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL;

SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset
GROUP BY review_score
ORDER BY review_score;

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category_name,
       SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
       ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
       SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_spending
FROM olist_customers_dataset c
JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN olist_order_payments_dataset p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(AVG(op.total_payment)::numeric, 2) AS average_order_value
FROM olist_orders_dataset o
JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment
    FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
    GROUP BY order_id
) op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category_name,
       SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_products_dataset p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
  ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
ORDER BY revenue_rank;

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_spending
    FROM olist_customers_dataset c
    JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN olist_order_payments_dataset p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT customer_unique_id,
       total_spending
FROM customer_spending
WHERE total_spending > (SELECT AVG(total_spending) FROM customer_spending)
ORDER BY total_spending DESC;
SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage_of_orders FROM olist_orders_dataset GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category_name,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
    FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
    JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
        ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    GROUP BY p.product_id, category_name
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    category_name,
    revenue
FROM (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        category_name,
        revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn
    FROM product_revenue
) sub
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY category_name, revenue DESC;

WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment
    FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
    GROUP BY order_id
),
monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
           SUM(ot.total_payment) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM olist_orders_dataset o
    JOIN order_totals ot ON o.order_id = ot.order_id
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
)
SELECT month,
       SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_revenue
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month;

WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment
    FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
    GROUP BY order_id
),
avg_payment AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_payment) AS avg_total
    FROM order_totals
)
SELECT ot.order_id, ot.total_payment
FROM order_totals ot
CROSS JOIN avg_payment ap
WHERE ot.total_payment > ap.avg_total
ORDER BY ot.total_payment DESC;

SELECT
    customer_id,
    MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS most_recent_order_date,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders
FROM olist_orders_dataset
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY total_orders DESC;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
        SUM(p.payment_value) AS revenue
    FROM olist_orders_dataset o
    JOIN (
        SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS payment_value
        FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
        GROUP BY order_id
    ) p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
)
SELECT
    month,
    revenue,
    revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_change,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))::numeric / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100
        END
    , 2) AS mom_pct_change
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month;
